tasks.title: Embed CEL for conditional logic
tasks.description: CEL evaluation for risk conditions, promotion criteria, rollback triggers. No bespoke DSL.

tasks.title: SQLite Store backend + migrations
tasks.description: Implement store.Store on SQLite with migrations; crash-safe per-transition persist.

tasks.title: Engine API surface
tasks.description: Central engine library: plan/apply/verify/promote/rollback/observe/schedule. Transport- and storage-agnostic.

tasks.title: plan/diff before apply
tasks.description: Compute and surface a plan/diff to humans and agents before anything is applied.

tasks.title: Advisory locks + reconcile serialization

tasks.description: Compute blast-radius score: target criticality, environment, change type, blast radius, rollout strategy.

tasks.title: Single approval gate
tasks.description: CEL-configurable threshold; below auto-proceeds, above/sensitive needs one approval (approve/reject/block).

tasks.title: Dependency DAG

tasks.title: Progressive delivery strategies
tasks.description: Rolling, canary, blue-green with configurable traffic shifting.

tasks.title: Target conformance suite
tasks.description: Shared suite proving idempotency, fingerprint stability, health semantics — every target must pass.

tasks.title: gRPC plugin protocol
tasks.description: go-plugin-style gRPC contract + versioning for third-party targets.

tasks.title: SSH/VM target (dumb)
tasks.description: First-party SSH/VM target with stamped-manifest/checksum drift verification. Leanest end-to-end proof.

tasks.title: FTP target (dumb)
tasks.description: First-party FTP target with stamped-manifest drift verification.

tasks.title: Kubernetes target (rich)
tasks.description: First-party Kubernetes target with native Observe against live state. No core K8s dependency leaks.

tasks.title: Git integration (webhook + poll)
tasks.description: HMAC-verified GitHub webhook + periodic poll (drift heartbeat); per-repo GitHub App/deploy-key auth.

tasks.title: Reconcile loop + drift
tasks.description: Read desired from Git, Observe targets, fingerprint diff; detect/alert/reconcile; configurable verification depth.

tasks.title: Rollback (manual/agent/auto)
tasks.description: Auto signals: Health fail, smoke-test fail, step error/timeout. Roll back by re-applying prior manifest.

tasks.title: Scheduled deployments
tasks.description: ScheduledRollout queue in the Store; due-schedule firing on reconcile tick (human or agent).

tasks.title: Environment promotion
tasks.description: Staged dev→staging→prod path + independent per-env configs; everything configurable.

tasks.title: SecretProvider + vault
tasks.description: Never store secrets locally; vault integration; workload-identity auth with vault-managed bootstrap fallback.

tasks.title: bolt audit + secret redaction
tasks.description: Structured bolt audit for all actions; redact secret material at the logging boundary; immutable attribution.

tasks.title: RBAC taxonomy + auth
tasks.description: Scoped roles bound to human/CI/agent identities; rollouts.apply-to-prod distinct from rollouts.status.

tasks.title: Artifact provenance verify
tasks.description: cosign/SLSA signature + provenance verification per target, configurable, secure default. Critical for agent rollouts.

tasks.title: Agent guardrails
tasks.description: Non-bypassable policy floor + emergency freeze kill-switch + fortify agent rate-limit. Hard limits, not advisory.

tasks.title: CLI (one-shot + daemon client)
tasks.description: Identical command surface; in-process engine or gRPC client. Cannot bypass gate or RBAC.

tasks.title: Daemon gRPC + REST gateway
tasks.description: gRPC mirroring engine ops + grpc-gateway REST for UI; mTLS/signed-token auth on every call.

tasks.title: MCP server (mcp-go)
tasks.description: Tools 1:1 to engine ops; embedded-in-daemon + standalone; authenticated + RBAC-scoped like every interface.

tasks.title: Self-observability
tasks.description: Daemon health endpoints + Prometheus metrics: reconcile latency, drift count, rollout outcomes.

tasks.title: UI dashboard (read-and-act)
tasks.description: Live rollout state, history, pending approvals, drift status over the REST gateway.
